text:
Elaine: Quick sync — planning a 4-week community tutorial series (refapp + quickstart + benchmark writeup). Goal: attract contributors and capture inbound leads. thinking week 1 author call, week 2 drafts, week 3 PRs, week 4 launch + webinar. Thoughts?
Samir: love it. can we highlight 1 benchmark (latency/cost) per tutorial? simple reproducible steps.
Dylan: @Samir yes — devrel can create lab repo templates. i'll own contributor docs and the starter notebooks.
Michelle: i'll draft three launch post snippets (short, long, tweet thread) and a messaging matrix for audiences (startup, platform, enterprise).
Elaine: owners: @Dylan labs, @Samir benchmarks, @Michelle marketing copy. @Nate can you route inbound leads from the signup form to SDR queue?
Nate: yep — send form -> /webhooks/marketing -> sdr-triage. can we add a UTM param so we know it's community-tutorial?
Michelle: will create UTM: utm_campaign=community_tutorial_series_2026 and short links for CTAs.
Dylan: i opened a skeleton repo and PR: https://github.com/redwood/refapp-tutorials/pull/12 — includes templates and a CONTRIBUTING.md. pls review.
Samir: for benchmark, suggest standard conf: model=gpt-7b, seq=512, batch=4. snippet:
```
run_benchmark --model gpt-7b --seq 512 --batch 4 --reps 3
```
Dylan: nice — i'll add a small harness and example output files (latency.csv, cost_estimate.md).
Elaine: timeline proposal: kickoff 03/02, draft review 03/10, PRs merged 03/17, launch + webinar 03/24. everyone ok?
Michelle: timeline works. i'll reserve webinar slot and draft promo calendar.
Nate: i'll wire the lead form and tag flows: webhook + tag=community_tutorial_2026 + assign to SDR Emma.
ops-bot: Reminder set: author-call invite scheduled for 2026-03-01 09:00 (UTC).
Dylan: i'll reach out to 4 community contributors that fit the use-cases (search, RAG, embeddings). tagging @Michelle for asset needs.
Michelle: will make a one-pager, 6 promo social cards, and a 10-slide webinar deck — less than 2 weeks to final assets? should be fine.
Elaine: great — i'll consolidate tasks in the marketing board (link: https://app.asana.com/0/board/12345) and send calendar invites. thanks team! :tada:
